1912
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 14 Cont.
Aug. 6th A. Ahearn began his week of serving at 5}-his first ap- pointment since he left the seraphcate
Aug. 13 Rev. Fr. Kiniry and Fr. Solanus went to Mt. Hope with the Altar-boys where they played a good game of ball with their seniors 1-7. After lunch they took good swim and there played even harder than in the ball-campus-They did not sweat so much however! They also visited the Sisters Chapel and said the litany of St. Joseph. They: arrived home at the Monastery a little before 7("Disapointed")
Aug. 15 Feast of Assumption B.V.M. A.M. Services well attended, but not very many received. At Vespers not announced, four good servers at least were present L. Schaefer, A. Ahearn, J. Fitzpatrick, G. Gorman.
Aug. 16 Rev. Fr. Meizer from Carey, 0 .- - the Lourdes of America arrived and said Holy Mass next day Aug. 17.
August 19th Rev. Fr. Ignatius O.M.Cap. assembled the F.F and BB. of N. Y. for their annual retreat to conclude Aug. 24th & 3 pt During 1st week Rev. Fr. Bonavent. went to Our Lady of Angels' Church in Harlem. Fr. Solanus - to our Lady of . Sorrows - Pitt St. During these two weeks the Minor Ser- vers (Altar boys) gave considerable Edification, though there were some remarks made that they received Holy Com. rather seldom.
Sept. 2nd Labor-day Festival in Church with M.C. and then to Franz's Park.
3rd Professor Married at 5 o clock Mass - Thus began his new State of life with God in a Christian -
Page 15 Tho's Fagan and Patrick Laughlin served the Holy Mass - got a treat from Prof. (Read to here. ? )
Sept. 8 Feast of Nativity of B.V.Mary Fr. Sol and a few of the Altar-boys concluded Novena in hon. of our dear Lady of Perpetual Help - 1st Patron of Society.
